sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which 
performed every six month as indicated by M6 in the title block. The same 
procedures will be applied for all pumps have the same technical specification 
mentioned at the last page of this document.

Mazout (Screw pump) transfer pump function to transfer mazout from main tank to 
another main tank or to transfer mazout from main tank to daily tank.

المسودة الأولى بدأها المهندس. عماد الدين علي عبد الله، تم اختباره في 16 مارس/آذار

مراقبة الجودة م. سمير عبد الجليل، معتمد من م. مختار عبد اللطيف

sections.text: Return Pump into Service

Operate the 
 pump by coordination with the shift engineer.

Ensure that the pump is OK, 
 direction of rotation is correct and record the readings of pressure, 
 temperature, vibration, according to the technical specification table, and compare with the previous reading.
